summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the rich repository, without running tests, installing packages, or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes one (type, title) tuple; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal and returning True/False with the required docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only, mocked wrapper). Nothing was executed, so the tests and mypy are unverified. Edge case: with TERM=dumb, set_window_title returns True even though control() writes nothing, consistent with show_cursor and per the spec's terminal-only check.
